audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra priestly ordination narrative text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for ordination of Aaron and sons, washing, garments, anointing, sin/purification offering, burnt offering, ordination ram, blood on ear/thumb/toe, seven-day entrance command.

familiar.text: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;

verses.restored: And assemble all congregation at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.restored: Moses did as YHWH commanded him, and congregation assembled at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.restored: Moses said to congregation, This is the matter that YHWH commanded to be done.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.

verses.restored: Moses brought Aaron and his sons near and washed them with water.

familiar.text: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

verses.restored: He placed breastpiece upon him, and put into breastpiece the Urim and Thummim.

familiar.text: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.

verses.restored: He set turban on his head, and on turban at front he set gold plate, holy crown, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.restored: Moses took anointing oil and anointed dwelling-place and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

familiar.text: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.

verses.restored: He sprinkled from it on altar seven times, anointed altar and all its vessels, basin and its stand, to sanctify them.

familiar.text: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.

verses.restored: He poured from anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him, to sanctify him.

familiar.text: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

familiar.text: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.

verses.restored: He slaughtered it, and Moses took blood/life, put it on horns of altar all around with his finger, and purified/cleansed altar; he poured blood/life at base of altar and sanctified it, to make atonement/covering upon it.

familiar.text: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.

verses.restored: He took all fat on inward parts, lobe of liver, two kidneys and their fat, and Moses turned them into smoke on altar.

familiar.text: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.

verses.restored: But bull, its skin, flesh, and dung he burned with fire outside camp, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.restored: He slaughtered it, and Moses threw blood/life on altar all around.

familiar.text: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.restored: The ram he cut into its pieces, and Moses turned head, pieces, and fat into smoke.

familiar.text: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

familiar.text: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.restored: He slaughtered it, and Moses took from its blood/life and put on lobe of Aaron's right ear, thumb of his right hand, and big toe of his right foot.

familiar.text: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

verses.restored: He brought Aaron's sons near, and Moses put from blood/life on lobe of their right ear, thumb of their right hand, and big toe of their right foot; Moses threw blood/life on altar all around.

familiar.text: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.restored: He took fat, fat tail, all fat on inward parts, lobe of liver, two kidneys and their fat, and right thigh.

familiar.text: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:

verses.restored: From basket of unleavened bread that was before YHWH he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on fat portions and right thigh.

familiar.text: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

verses.restored: He put all on palms of Aaron and palms of his sons and waved them as wave offering before YHWH.

familiar.text: And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.

verses.restored: Moses took them from their palms and turned them into smoke on altar upon burnt offering; they were ordination/filling offerings for soothing scent, fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.restored: Moses took breast and waved it as wave offering before YHWH; from ram of ordination/filling it was Moses' portion, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses’ part; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.restored: Moses took from anointing oil and from blood/life that was on altar and sprinkled on Aaron, on his garments, on his sons, and on garments of his sons with him; he sanctified Aaron, his garments, his sons, and garments of his sons with him.

familiar.text: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

verses.restored: Moses said to Aaron and his sons, Boil flesh at entrance of tent of meeting, and there eat it and bread in basket of ordination/filling offerings, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

verses.restored: What remains from flesh and bread you shall burn with fire.

familiar.text: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

verses.restored: From entrance of tent of meeting you shall not go out seven days, until day of completing days of your ordination/filling; for seven days he shall fill your hand.

familiar.text: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.

verses.restored: As he has done this day, YHWH commanded to do, to make atonement/covering for you.

familiar.text: As he hath done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.

verses.restored: At entrance of tent of meeting you shall stay day and night seven days, and keep watch of YHWH's charge, so you do not die, for so I was commanded.

familiar.text: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.

verses.restored: Aaron and his sons did all matters that YHWH commanded by hand of Moses.

familiar.text: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

translation_notes: Leviticus 8 narrates performance of Exodus 29 ordination instructions.
Ordination/filling-hand idiom is preserved to show installation into service.
Blood/life on ear, thumb, and toe marks hearing, doing, and walking in consecrated service.
Seven-day staying at tent entrance is ritual formation and boundary, not arbitrary confinement.
safety_note: Priestly ordination is accountable service, not status entitlement. Ritual blood/life symbolism should be handled with solemnity and not sensationalized.
